intro: The Philippines is a presidential republic modelled partly on the United States.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is elected for a single six-year term and leads the government. Congress has a House of Representatives and a 24-member Senate.
The Bangsamoro region in Mindanao has its own autonomous government after a peace deal with Muslim rebels.

chapters.title: Big debates
text: President Rodrigo Duterte's 'war on drugs' from 2016 led to thousands of killings, and in 2025 he was arrested and sent to the International Criminal Court. The Philippines also disputes islands in the South China Sea with China.

keyTerms.meaning: An area with its own government for some matters.
